title: Moments from our recent community events
description: Explore snapshots from outreach programs, school activities, relief distribution, and volunteer-led support events.

items.shortDescription: Families received warm clothing, blankets, and dry food packs before winter.
Children received notebooks, bags, and learning kits for the new school term.
Volunteer doctors provided health screenings and basic medicines for local families.
Essential nutrition packs were distributed to low-income families.
Volunteers visited households to map urgent support and follow-up needs.
